PERSONAL EXPLORATION SUMMARY

Possible fields for your mini-project

Your next steps

  1. Choose one or two of the suggested fields that genuinely interest you.
  2. Explore the common academic resources below. Note at least two useful non-AI sources and what you learned.
  3. Define one specific, achievable engineering problem, intended output and method.
  4. Discuss scope, facilities, cost and originality with your mentor before finalising a title.
  5. Use AI for explanations or planning when helpful, but check claims and keep a record of sources.

Important: This is a preference-based suggestion, not an aptitude test, project approval or assessment grade. The final topic must be agreed with your mentor and follow departmental requirements.
